Recommendation_Principle: Increase dietary diversity and adequate energy/protein intake

Recommendation_Principle: Prioritize iron-rich foods and vitamin-C-rich foods alongside clinician-directed iron therapy
Foods_To_Emphasize: Pulses; millets; leafy greens; legumes; meat/fish/eggs if permitted; amla/citrus/guava
Foods_To_Limit: Do not represent food alone as treatment for clinically significant anaemia

Recommendation_Principle: Increase calcium-rich foods while respecting supplement/medication timing

Recommendation_Principle: Distribute carbohydrate across meals and emphasize fibre/protein-rich foods

Evidence_Source: WHO healthy diet principles + diabetes nutrition practice

Recommendation_Principle: Emphasize minimally processed foods and moderate sodium exposure

Foods_To_Limit: Highly salted packaged foods, pickles/papad in excess, processed meats

Recommendation_Principle: Increase fibre-containing foods and adequate fluid intake if clinically appropriate
Foods_To_Emphasize: Whole grains; pulses; vegetables; fruit; seeds
Foods_To_Limit: Abrupt extreme fibre increases without adequate fluids

Recommendation_Principle: Use tolerable small meals and hydration; escalate clinically when severe
Foods_To_Emphasize: Simple tolerated meals; dry foods; ginger-containing foods where appropriate
Foods_To_Limit: Large greasy meals and individual nausea triggers

Recommendation_Principle: Assess nutrient adequacy explicitly and use fortified foods/supplements under clinical guidance
Foods_To_Emphasize: Pulses; soy; nuts/seeds; whole grains; fortified plant beverages; vegetables

Evidence_Source: Nutrition evidence + WHO healthy diet principles

Recommendation_Principle: Use diverse pulses, dairy/eggs where permitted and iron-rich plant foods

Foods_To_Limit: Over-reliance on refined grains and sweets
Evidence_Source: ICMR-NIN food composition + WHO nutrition counselling

Recommendation_Principle: Increase nutrient-dense energy/protein intake with clinical assessment
Foods_To_Emphasize: Dairy/fortified alternatives; pulses; soy; nuts/seeds; eggs/meat/fish if permitted
Foods_To_Limit: Low-nutrient high-sugar foods as the primary strategy

Recommendation_Principle: Review total dietary pattern, portions and clinical activity advice
Foods_To_Emphasize: Vegetables; whole grains; pulses; lean protein; whole fruit

Recommendation_Principle: Use pasteurized, thoroughly cooked and hygienically prepared foods
